notes: Refined existing stories for clarity, strict layering, and non-overlap across schema, logic, integration, fallback, and testing.

change_log.value: Define strict Pydantic input/output contract for distance calculation including origin/destination coordinates, optional units (miles/km), and normalized response fields (distance_meters, distance_text, duration_seconds, duration_text).
Implement core distance and duration calculation using Google Routes API, including request construction, response parsing, and normalization into the defined schema. No fallback logic included.
change_log.note: Separated core logic from fallback explicitly

change_log.value: Integrate distance calculation into provider_search_service and clinical_trials_service, and expose via evaluate_care_facade ensuring consistent inclusion of distance and duration in downstream responses.
change_log.note: Tightened integration scope and consistency requirement

change_log.value: Develop unit tests for schema validation and calculation logic, plus integration tests validating end-to-end distance propagation through services and facade, including API response correctness.
change_log.note: Expanded test coverage to include schema validation

change_log.value: Implement fallback distance calculation using Haversine formula when Google Routes API fails, including timeout handling, invalid coordinate handling, and graceful degradation (distance only, no duration).

MAINT-DIST-S1.title: Define Distance Calculation Schema and Contract
MAINT-DIST-S1.description: Define strict Pydantic input/output contract for distance calculation including origin/destination coordinates, optional units (miles/km), and normalized response fields (distance_meters, distance_text, duration_seconds, duration_text).

MAINT-DIST-S2.title: Implement Core Distance Calculation Logic
MAINT-DIST-S2.description: Implement core distance and duration calculation using Google Routes API, including request construction, response parsing, and normalization into the defined schema. No fallback logic included.

MAINT-DIST-S3.title: Integrate Distance Logic into Services and Facade
MAINT-DIST-S3.description: Integrate distance calculation into provider_search_service and clinical_trials_service, and expose via evaluate_care_facade ensuring consistent inclusion of distance and duration in downstream responses.

MAINT-DIST-S4.title: Distance Calculation Unit and Integration Tests
MAINT-DIST-S4.description: Develop unit tests for schema validation and calculation logic, plus integration tests validating end-to-end distance propagation through services and facade, including API response correctness.

MAINT-DIST-S5.title: Distance Calculation Fallback and Error Handling
MAINT-DIST-S5.description: Implement fallback distance calculation using Haversine formula when Google Routes API fails, including timeout handling, invalid coordinate handling, and graceful degradation (distance only, no duration).
